content:
If one or more nodes in your cluster has storage space less than the minimum value of 1) 20% of
available storage space, or 2) 20 GiB of storage space, basic write operations like adding documents
and creating indexes can start to fail. the section called “Calculating storage requirements”
provides a summary of how OpenSearch Service uses disk space.
To avoid issues, monitor the FreeStorageSpace metric in the OpenSearch Service console and
create CloudWatch alarms to trigger when FreeStorageSpace drops below a certain threshold.
GET /_cat/allocation?v also provides a useful summary of shard allocation and disk usage. To
resolve issues associated with a lack of storage space, scale your OpenSearch Service domain to use
larger instance types, more instances, or more EBS-based storage.
